description.content: Returns all the cross border movements for the specified merchant for the specified report date range.

query.description: (Required) The start date for the query i.e. when movements were reported as arrived at the destination.
(Required) The end date (inclusive) for the query i.e. when movements were reported as arrived at the destination.
The warehouse location id to query i.e both source and destination locations.
Client suggested limit to restrict the number of movements per buffer query on a page.
The cursor is an indication of the first item tracking to include in the response.

variable.description: (Required) The Zalando specific UUID representing a merchant.

response.name: Returns a list of all the cross-border movements in the requested date range.

variable.description: (Required) The Zalando specific UUID representing a merchant.
